category: Structures that were once the world's tallest man-made structures
explanation: The Eiffel Tower, Burj Khalifa, Empire State Building, and Great Pyramid of Giza all held the record for being the tallest man-made structure in the world at some point in history. The Colosseum, while an iconic ancient landmark, was never the tallest in the world.

category: Four Great Inventions of Ancient China
explanation: Compass, Gunpowder, Paper, and Movable Type are traditionally recognized as the Four Great Inventions of Ancient China. The Steam Engine was developed in 18th-century Great Britain.

category: Homographs with Distinct Meanings and Pronunciations
explanation: Four of the words (Bow, Lead, Wind, Tear) are homographs that have at least two completely distinct meanings, each with a different pronunciation. 'Read,' while having different pronunciations for its present and past tense forms, refers to the same fundamental action of deciphering text, making its meaning difference one of tense rather than distinct concept.
